penalty.alpha: k_ub + 1, k_ub = validated greedy cover size on the reduced instance

instance_selection.primary: smallest rho in rho_grid with 0 < q_after <= q_max on the full fit partition
instance_selection.if_all_q_after_above_q_max: restricted cohort: order fit pairs by sha256('20261104:' + pair_id), take the first N pairs with N decreasing from |fit| at the smallest rho with q_after > 0, stop at the first N with 0 < q_after <= q_max; record the manifest
instance_selection.if_all_q_after_zero: solved_by_reduction; report the limitation; G2 not reached

greedy.rule: max uncovered gain, lowest config_id on ties, then reverse-delete by descending config_id

qaoa.optimizer: SPSA (alpha 0.602, gamma 0.101, A 0.1*iterations, c 0.1, first step 0.2 rad)
qaoa.hamiltonian_scaling: divide h, J and offset by max |coefficient|
qaoa.angle_selection: final angles of the init with the lowest mean of its last f_plus and f_minus

repair.input: lowest-energy sample of the run (QAOA: confirmation shots)
repair.rule: same routine as greedy, on the original incidence

solution_selection: smallest raw cover-feasible catalogue among all samples in budget, lexicographic tie-break

amendments.text: the original split.json was not shipped with the calibration sweep; the split is rebuilt with freeze_split (PR #16) from data/udis-d/udis-d-development-v1.json; its 200 calibration pairs equal the 200 audited pairs but its sha256 differs from the receipt; the original replaces it when available and characterization is rerun
no validation sweep exists; evaluation partitions with no rows are reported as not_measured; no generalization claim

in addition to the primary instance chosen by instance_selection, one secondary run uses the full fit instance at rho 0.10 with q_max raised to its q_after; same budget; selection rule secondary_beyond_q_max; gate status SECONDARY; it never replaces the primary result

W2 is the smallest raw cover-feasible QAOA catalogue over all QAOA runs in budget, ties broken by the sorted config list, then lower p, then lower seed; with no raw cover-feasible sample, W2 is the smallest repaired catalogue under the same tie-break and is labelled hybrid_quantum_classical_repair
